item.subject: science
item.stem:
Navya's class lists what people receive from a nearby mangrove wetland: fish and crabs for food, shelter that softens storm waves, and cleaner water filtered by plant roots. Ecosystem components depend on each other and support life processes.

Which claim best explains how ecosystems benefit humans?

options.A: Humans benefit because interdependent ecosystem parts support life processes and provide resources and services such as food, wave shelter, and cleaner water.
options.B: Mangrove is the same as a factory, so the benefits come only from machines, not from living and non-living parts working together.
options.C: People receive food from the wetland even if no plants, water, or living links exist there.
options.D: The only benefit that counts is the green colour of the leaves, not food, shelter, or cleaner water.
